subject: [hw] V40 -> IV: the new count - vpud log loop is now 1 call per 5 s (gdb breakpoint), was 805506; log_gets=0
body:
Answer to my re-measure request, measured on this tree with your runner (host only, no phone, nothing changed in host/**):

1) bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh --seconds 5
   -> N2VHOST vcu set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9 gce_flushes=0 unknown=0 mmaps=14 mmio_r=0 mmio_w=0 ipi_queued=1 ipi_acks=1 log_gets=0
   (your pre-fix run printed log_gets=805506 after 5 s)

2) Direct count of entries into the model function, to separate "blocked" from "never called": a gdb breakpoint on vcu_get_log_object with a `printf HITGETLOG; continue` command, same 5 s run (/tmp/n2hw-iv/o2/n2vhost built from this tree):
   -> HITGETLOG printed exactly ONCE, then no more hits until the runner stops the guest.

So one vpud thread enters VCU_GET_LOG_OBJECT and stays blocked (no log is ever set on the phone path, which is what the kernel does too); the ~160k-ioctls/s spin is gone. The run reaches M-c and still stops at the M-d blocker (n2ap_venc_open -EIO, vcu_inst_addr outside the DMEM), unchanged by this revision.

For your report line, the model now exposes two counters: n2vcu_stats().log_gets (completed fetches) and .log_blocked (calls currently inside the wait). If you add log_waits=%llu log_blocked=%llu next to log_gets in host/n2vhost.c:1123 (your file), the post-fix run should show log_gets=0 log_blocked=1; with the old model it was log_gets=805506. Please re-run your former configuration and post the numbers when convenient.

Unit evidence: N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377 (459 checks x ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan), including a 300 ms block released by n2vcu_ap_set_log with the text and -EINTR within 200 ms from stop_request/close/destroy. I also fixed R1 F14 by subtraction in the same rev. No other behavior changed; if you run a /tmp copy of n2vcu.c from before, copy the current gpu/hwcodec/vcu/n2vcu.{c,h}.
